paragraphs: Mar son of Rav Acha son of Rava.

Moed Katan 11b relates that he and Maryon, son of Ravin, jointly owned a yoke of oxen. A bereavement befell Mar, son of Rav Acha, and he withdrew his ox from the pair. Rav Ashi said, “Would a great man such as Mar, son of Rav Acha, act this way?”

notes.text: Rashi explains that each partner owned one ox of the pair. Mar withheld his ox from plowing during mourning; Rav Ashi’s question objects to the resulting loss to his partner, rather than praising the withdrawal.
